about: Texts with characters outside the Basic Multilingual Plane (emoji, mathematical letters, regional indicators, rare CJK) placed where a distance or a window is measured: between a negation cue and the text it governs, between a framing phrase and a quoted payload, or right after a match. The scanner measures those distances in code points. Decision and sorted finding ids are the scanner's (0.6.8). Rows of the last family also carry the matched text the scanner reports, which is cut at 50 code points and read with a window of code points around a keyword.
